capital.evidence_quote: Havana is the capital, major port, and leading commercial center of the Republic of Cuba

currency.evidence_quote: The Cuban Peso (CUP) is the official national currency in circulation across Cuba

timezone.evidence_quote: Cuba observes Cuba Standard Time UTC-5 and daylight saving time UTC-4

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential domestic supply is 110V 60 Hz, with 220V available in modern hotels

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The national electrical grid frequency is standardized at 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Outlets in Cuba accommodate North American Type A/B plugs as well as European Type C plugs

sources.title: Ministerio del Interior de la República de Cuba (MININT)

police.evidence_quote: Dial 106 for emergency police (Policía Nacional Revolucionaria) across Cuba

sources.title: Ministerio de Salud Pública de Cuba (MINSAP)

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 104 for urgent medical emergencies and ambulance dispatch in Cuba

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 105 for fire and rescue services throughout Cuba

general.evidence_quote: 106 functions as the central dispatch contact number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist assistance and Asistur emergency coordination centers operate across Havana and Varadero

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Küba sokakları güvenlidir; temel ilaç/gıda tedarik sıkıntıları ve ABD ESTA iptali kuralına dikkat edilmelidir.
advisory_headline.en: Cuba is generally safe regarding violent crime; note medicine shortages and US ESTA ineligibility rule.
advisory_headline.de: Kuba ist gewaltarm; Versorgungsengpässe bei Medikamenten und US-ESTA-Ausschluss beachten.
advisory_headline.ru: На Кубе низкий уровень насильственной преступности; учитывайте дефицит медикаментов и отмену ESTA для США.
advisory_headline.es: Cuba es segura en cuanto a delitos violentos; tenga en cuenta la escasez de insumos y la regla ESTA de EE. UU.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Cuba measure approximately 12.5 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Cuba reach 15.2 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: US credit cards do not work in Cuba. Complete the mandatory D'Viajeros entry form within 48 hours before travel. ETECSA (Cubacel Tur) offers tourist eSIMs with pre-purchased data; download offline maps before arriving.

sources.title: D'Viajeros Portal de Declaración del Viajero

esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: D'Viajeros digital traveler declaration is mandatory for all arriving passengers in Cuba

local_apps.name: D'Viajeros
local_apps.description: Official mandatory online traveler entry declaration portal required before boarding flights to Cuba.

local_apps.name: La Nave
local_apps.description: The local Cuban ride-hailing app operating in Havana with transparent cash/transfer fares.

local_apps.name: Maps.me
local_apps.description: Essential offline map tool for Cuba where internet connectivity can be intermittent.

local_apps.name: Transfermóvil
local_apps.description: National mobile payment system widely used by Cuban residents and long-term visitors.

tr.conditions: Türk vatandaşları turistik seyahatlerde Küba Turist Kartı (Tarjeta del Turista) veya e-Visa almak zorundadır. Seyahat sağlık sigortası ve D'Viajeros formu zorunludur. DİKKAT: Küba ziyareti ABD ESTA hakkını iptal eder.

source.title: Küba Göç İdaresi ve e-Visa Portalı

us.conditions: US citizens must travel under one of 12 authorized OFAC categories (e.g. Support for the Cuban People); pure tourism is prohibited under US law.

source.title: US Department of the Treasury OFAC

de.conditions: German citizens must hold a Tourist Card (Tarjeta del Turista) valid for 90 days. IMPORTANT: Visiting Cuba revokes US ESTA eligibility.

gb.conditions: British passport holders must acquire a Tourist Card (Tarjeta del Turista). Note: Prior travel to Cuba cancels US ESTA eligibility.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать на Кубу без визы на срок до 90 дней в течение каждого 180-дневного периода. Форма D'Viajeros обязательна.

dos.title: Bring essential toiletries and medications
dos.description: Pharmacies face severe shortages; bring your own pain relievers, antibiotics, sunscreen, and mosquito repellent.

dos.title: Carry Euros or US Dollars in cash
dos.description: US-issued bank cards do not work due to embargo rules; carry physical cash (Euros are widely preferred).

dos.title: Fill the D'Viajeros form within 48 hours
dos.description: Submit your health and customs declaration on dviajeros.mitrans.gob.cu and keep the QR code on your phone.

donts.title: Beware of US ESTA invalidation!
donts.description: Anyone who travels to Cuba loses eligibility for the US ESTA visa waiver program and must apply for a regular US visa.

donts.title: Don't engage with 'Jineteros' (street hustlers)
donts.description: Politely decline unsolicited street offers for cheap cigars, salsa clubs, or private paladares.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% in restaurants and leaving small cash tips for musicians, drivers, and casa particular hosts is customary and deeply appreciated.
